title: Harden ignored:document-structure coverage guard
description: Audit found ignored:document-structure can hide meaningful prose attached to chapter/appendix/category headings. Add guard in sourceInventoryCoverage.ts / source-coverage tests. Minimum: generated-record sentinel tests for all new intro phrases (findings 1-5). Prefer general guard: source-inventory enhancement distinguishing empty structural headings from headings with body prose before first child section, and/or source-coverage assertions that high-risk headings with prose do not resolve only to ignored:document-structure (Feats, Appendix PH-A: Conditions, Using Ability Scores, subclass categories, Appendix MM-B). Keep ignored:document-structure valid for truly structural headings with no gameplay prose - do not force every chapter heading into a rule record. Depends on findings 1-5. Commit 3.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #227 (branch eshyra-g9im-intro-prose). 12 new rule records (rule:feats, rule:conditions, rule:using-ability-scores, rule:appendix-mm-b-nonplayer-characters, 8 subclass overviews); all 12 headings reclassified from ignored:document-structure to record. Sentinels + coverage assertions added. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack + verify:worktree green.
